prompt:
INPUT: text only — no reference image is needed; do not reuse earlier conversation images. For the image tool, omit referenced_image_paths and num_last_images_to_include.

SOURCE: Vikavolt (투구뿌논), bug / electric type.

PALETTE: blue, orange, yellow.

STYLE: Premium glossy anime-mecha promotional key art with clean linework, vivid controlled color, dimensional 2.5D shading and dense but organized hard-surface detail. Match the face and armor at the same polished rendering intensity.

SUBJECT: A female mecha personification character with Vikavolt as her motif — the creature reimagined as an armored adult woman, not a mascot costume or a creature suit: her plates, undersuit, hair and ornaments carry its palette, markings and shapes. She wears its features as costume; nothing is carried, mounted or put on display. Her skin is human skin.

WEAR: the blue carapace becomes a dome-backed mantle over her shoulders and upper back, its rim framing both shoulders; the large spike becomes pointed edges on her plates; the wide, flat wings become a split cape falling from her shoulders, cut in the same shape and colors; its markings (yellow rings; yellow spot) become painted lines and patterns on her plates and undersuit.

FACE (her own structure, not the style's default face): angular face, balanced length, medium width; square broad jaw; almond eyes, medium size, level outer corners, average spacing; angled brows; short nose with upturned tip; thin lips.

HAIR: long windswept, choppy bangs.

FORM — LIGHT: one close-fitting armor layer: slim plates at the shoulders, forearms, hips and shins over a fitted undersuit, joints free, a slim readable outline. No helmet; at most a slim headband or temple sensor.

OUTPUT: one dynamic action image that is also this form's card art. Vertical 2:3 frame, full body with head and feet inside the frame and clear margins, no foreground occlusion, face toward the camera (front or three-quarter, never a back view). Default stance is a standing, card-ready pose; motion, effects and setting may be dramatic while her design stays readable.

Chosen settings below override the default stance and camera; her identity and form stay fixed.
Camera: Vertical 2:3 portrait (1024×1536).

IDENTITY (chosen details override the automatic look)
apparent age: 20s — adult woman in her twenties

ONE FIGURE ONLY. No second character, no creature beside her, no text, no lettering, no logo, no watermark, no speech bubble, no frame border.

ANATOMY: natural adult proportions. No body-part enlargement, no extra limbs; her worn features are costume, never extra limbs.

BODY: a normal human body — one head, two arms and two legs, each joined at its natural joint; elbows, knees and wrists bend the human way. Hands and feet may be partly hidden by the pose, what she holds or the frame.

HANDS: natural human hands. Gloves are full-finger and close-fitting; plates, water, sparks and effects stay off the fingers.
source: Actual local prompt.html rendered in Chromium; planner query and saved UI selections loaded, free-text fields entered through form controls.
